jobs.title: Sales Analyst
jobs.description: The Sales Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day execution of CRM hygiene, data integrity, and serves as a backup to frontline operational support for the Sales organization. This role assumes ownership of CRM cleanliness and operational enforcement, allowing the Sales Operations Manager to focus on broader tooling, cross-functional initiatives, and project leadership. This role is highly operational and execution-focused, with a strong emphasis on data quality, process adherence, issue resolution, and responsiveness to Sales needs. Core Responsibilities 1. CRM Hygiene & Data Integrity (Primary Focus) This role takes over day-to-day ownership of CRM hygiene and enforcement from the Sales Operations Manager. Own CRM data quality standards across all Sales-facing objects. Execute daily, weekly, and monthly hygiene routines to ensure data accuracy and consistency. Enforce expectations for: Required fields and field completeness Opportunity stage progression and close-date accuracy Account and hierarchy usage Activity logging and basic usage standards Identify, triage, and remediate: Duplicate records Orphaned accounts, contacts, and opportunities Stale or inactive pipeline Incomplete, conflicting, or inconsistent data entries Partner with Sales leadership and Sales Operations Manager to reinforce accountability for CRM usage and compliance. Serve as the operational owner for CRM cleanliness, escalating systemic issues or automation gaps to the Sales Operations Manager and IT as needed. Maintain and distribute standard Salesforce reports and dashboards to provide operational visibility (non-analytics, non‑predictive). This scope directly aligns with known CRM health challenges and ongoing cleanup initiatives documented in Sales Operations priorities. 2. Sales Help Desk & Frontline Support (Shared Responsibility) This role provides tier ‑ 1 and tier ‑ 2 support for Sales in partnership with the Sales Operations Manager. Act as a first point of contact for Sales-related operational questions and issues, particularly during U.S. off-hours. Support Salesforce and tool usage questions including: Access issues Routing errors Workflow confusion Basic reporting requests Triage incoming issues and determine whether they can be resolved operationally or require escalation. Document issues clearly and escalate to the Sales Operations Manager or IT with strong business context. Maintain FAQs, internal documentation, and repeatable guidance to reduce recurring help desk volume. Follow established escalation and support processes when technical intervention is required. 3. Process Execution & Operational Support Support execution of Sales Operations processes such as: Pipeline reviews Deal hygiene checks Territory or account updates Tool and process rollouts Execute defined operational playbooks and recurring processes with consistency. Assist the Sales Operations Manager in operational projects by owning defined workstreams or execution tasks. Monitor adherence to Sales processes and surface gaps or breakdowns proactively. Provide feedback from frontline execution that informs process improvement and tooling decisions. Ideal Background 2–5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Operations, or CRM-focused analyst roles. Strong hands-on experience working in Salesforce in a Sales environment. High attention to detail and comfort working in data-heavy workflows. Experience supporting frontline Sales teams in a help-desk or enablement capacity. Comfortable following defined processes with consistency and discipline. Strong written communication skills and ability to work effectively across time zones. jobs.title: Market Research Executive
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Market Research Executive – Outbound to support and scale Sprinto’s outbound pipeline through high-quality data research, enrichment, and CRM management. This role will be responsible for identifying ICP-fit accounts, building and enriching outbound databases, maintaining CRM hygiene, and enabling structured lead distribution for SDRs and AEs. The ideal candidate combines strong research skills with hands-on experience in outbound data tools and CRM systems. They should be comfortable working with enrichment platforms, automation workflows, and data governance practices to ensure accurate, reliable, and campaign-ready outbound data. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
